title: 카톡 원문과 실시간 주문·분배 이력의 읽기 전용 대조

criteria.performance: Bounded caches hold only pure normalized strings and exact phrase regular expressions, never entity identities or completion decisions. The matching semantics and ambiguity guards are unchanged.
criteria.partialDisplay: Each uniquely identified request with consistent signed quantity evidence and native distribution status can have a green evidence box even when other requests in its message remain unresolved. Never infer entire-message completion from that box. Waiting and failed reads are labeled separately from unconfirmed evidence.
criteria.combinedHistory: Unique same-year/week/customer/product/unit event after all distinct same-direction requests can match their complete sum, never a searched subset. Multiple events, mixed direction, approximate timestamps, duplicate request identities and truncated evidence are excluded. Native before/after remains intact. Saved customer alias may omit terminal 원예 only when all matching aliases identify one customer. 휘슬러 denotes exact ALSTROMERIA Whistler, not cultivar suffix variants.
criteria.pasteMatchedEvidence: Single-message paste analysis may project fully matched current customer/product names, quantity, unit and action into read-only evidence matching. Preserve original identity, exact timestamp and year/week markers, including 차 suffix. Incomplete mappings fall back to original text. Display that evidence is based on current analysis, not proof that the raw message was fully interpreted. No ERP or alias writes.
criteria.requestBalance: Read-only comparison of each unambiguous signed request and its unique ShipmentHistory change. Order history is never distribution evidence. All candidates, including partial changes, compete for event claims. A cancel/add transfer may have zero net stock effect without implying completion. Missing or competing evidence stays visible.
criteria.currentBalance: One exact OrderYear+OrderWeek+ProdKey ProductStock snapshot is a stored value, not historical proof or predicted availability. Missing/duplicate/non-finite snapshot is null, actual zero is valid. Current ViewShipment quantity is grouped without ShipmentDate multiplication. Never subtract requests again or mutate stock.
criteria.scope: One exact OrderYear and full OrderWeek with a maximum seven-day ChangeDtm range. The inbox sends ALL loaded messages grouped by original scope without a latest-200 slice. One scope accepts up to 1000 messages and 200000 text characters, rejecting the entire read on overflow rather than splitting competing claims or truncating. All messages in each scope compete for the same history events. SQL caps, 25-second reads and 30-second browser timeout remain unchanged. UI counts returned identities only and flags incomplete feed pagination. Unconfirmed request reasons remain visible without expanding details and do not assert non-processing.
criteria.orderHistory: Only OrderHistory.ColumName=주문수량 with non-no-op finite BeforeValue/AfterValue is order evidence; BeforeValue is original order and AfterValue is OrderDetail.OutQuantity, never 미발주수량.
criteria.matching: Exact catalog name, a unique exact parenthetical customer label, saved alias, or a deliberately enumerated unique bilingual catalog phrase, exact identity, explicit unit conversion, and source-time-before-event are required for a confirmed match. Parenthetical matching accepts ASCII/full-width parentheses but never a loose substring. Direct bunch/stem conversion uses Product.SteamOf1Bunch; box paths use Product.BunchOf1Box and Product.SteamOf1Box. When the product has no explicit conversion factor, one unique same-number and same-direction history event may be displayed only as UNIT_HISTORY_CANDIDATE with the input and ERP units visible. When an exact product alias is absent but the exact customer has exactly one later ShipmentHistory event with the requested number and direction, it may be displayed only as PRODUCT_HISTORY_CANDIDATE. Neither candidate status claims application. Ambiguous, approximate, date-only, deleted, complex, multi-date, competing, or truncated evidence never claims application.
criteria.advisory: POST is read-only and returns erpAction NONE; every status is evidence only.

crossYearFixture.description: A prior-year same-week event does not pair with the selected year.

dnspyEvidence.note: Main decompile review confirms FormOrderAdd records 주문수량 as BeforeValue original order and AfterValue OrderDetail.OutQuantity; 미발주수량 remains a separate history column.
